Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Sendiw
Message:
fix(web): relay frees half-closed clients promptly, per-user socket cap (RV6B-05)

A client that sends FIN after its upgrade request now closes the browser socket
(slot and upstream dial released at once, not after Go answers or the 10 s handshake
timeout). A per-user cap of 15 sockets across sessions keeps one user with many
sessions from filling the 256-socket process ceiling.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Sendiw
Message:
fix(web): stream relay frees upstream sockets, reserves slot before dial (RV6-03, RV6-08)

The browser socket owns the relay slot for its lifetime and kills the
upstream socket if it closes (or ws aborts the handshake) before handoff.
Slot reserved synchronously before the dial, per-process ceiling 256, the
upstream socket always has an error listener, early socket errors are
swallowed. Live specs: 6 aborted + 6 malformed upgrades then a working
socket (before: closed 4429); 8 concurrent -> 5 open, 3 BFF 429.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
